title: The Download: preserving minds and weighing open AI risks
summary: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Six wild ideas for perpetuating your mind As we age, we forget most of what we’ve experienced, yet there’s still undeniable continuity: At 30, or 50, or 70, you will still…
llm_summary: "The Download" explores cutting‑edge ideas for extending human consciousness, presenting six speculative approaches to preserve our memories and sense of self as we age. The piece also weighs the broader risks of open‑AI technologies, highlighting how rapid AI advances could amplify both the promise and the perils of trying to “download” or otherwise perpetuate the mind.
